title: Tesla comparison and charger availability
summary: Reviews in this topic compare the G70 with Tesla on charging access, interior design, and a few feature references, with many fragments only noting prior Tesla ownership rather than a clear evaluation of the G70.

positive.summary: The positive review praises a Tesla-like always-on rear camera display as a desired feature on the G70.

negative.summary: Negative reviews criticize the lack of a Tesla charging adapter and dislike Tesla-style minimalist design while noting Tesla chargers are more common.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mostly mention prior Tesla ownership or comparisons without a clear positive or negative judgment about the G70.

limitations: This cluster mixes several related but distinct subjects, including charger access, design preferences, desired features, and simple mentions of Tesla ownership.
Most sampled fragments are undetermined, so clear evaluative evidence is limited.
Examples are insufficient to support broader conclusions beyond the specific comparisons shown here.
